title: Comparison of Bone Effects With Copaxone and Interferon in Multiple Sclerosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if certain drugs commonly used to treat multiple sclerosis have an effect on bone health.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, age \> 18
* Able to understand and give informed consent
* Relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS)
* Treatment with interferons or Copaxone for at least one year prior to study entry

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known osteoporosis
* History of hypercalcemia
* Currently pregnant
* History of primary hyperparathyroidism, hyperthyroidism, or hypothyroidism
* Unstable medical condition
* Ongoing use of bisphosphonates
study_population: The participants must be female with clinical diagnosis of multiple sclerosis and have been using either Copaxone or interferon injections for the past 1 or more years.
